table_metadata: This table stores daily hotel performance metrics for the Sarova hotel. It contains historical and predicted occupancy percentages and daily revenue values. The data spans from 1 Jan 2024 to 31 Dec 2025 and is used for analyzing hotel demand, revenue trends, and seasonal patterns.

DATE_COL.description: Calendar date for the recorded hotel metrics,in format 'DD-MM-YYYY'

OCCUPANCY.description: Hotel room occupancy percentage for the given date, example values range from 0 to 100

REVENUE_USD.description: Total hotel revenue generated on the given date

YEAR.description: Year extracted from DATE_COL used for yearly analysis

QUARTER.description: Quarter derived from DATE_COL used for quarterly reporting

DATA_TYPE.description: Indicates whether the data point is historical or model predicted

MONTH.description: Month derived from DATE_COL used for monthly analysis
